# Travel Creations By Di

> Luxury travel curator based in the Texas Hill Country, serving families, couples, and social explorers since 2019.

## About
Travel Creations By Di is a boutique travel agency owned by Diane Mack, a Senior Travel Curator based in Ingram, TX. Specializing in Disney family adventures, European river cruises, ocean voyages, the Sip & Sail Social Club, and Texas Hill Country experiences.

## Services
- Disney Family Adventures (see Disney Expertise pillars below)
- European River Cruises (Rhine River, Christmas Markets)
- Ocean Cruises (Celebrity, Royal Caribbean, Norwegian, Virgin Voyages)
- Sip & Sail Social Club (curated group travel)
- Hill Country Insider (local Texas stays and wine trails)
- Tropical & Island Escapes (Hawaii, Caribbean, Mexico)
- Custom Curated Journeys

## Disney Expertise — Four Pillars
The /disney page is organized around four pillars of precision-planned Disney travel:
- Walt Disney World & Disneyland — mastering the parks with precision, from Genie+ to dining
- Disney Cruise Line — world-class magic at sea with expert stateroom and itinerary selection
- Adventures by Disney — VIP-guided group travel to the world's most iconic destinations
- Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa — the spirit of Aloha meets Disney excellence in Ko Olina

## Disney Featured Offers (2026 / 2027)
- Holiday Magic 2026 — November/December Wilderness Lodge stays
- Disney Cruise Line 2027 Launch — opening-day pricing on Disney's newest ship
- EPCOT 2026 Food & Wine Celebration — curated adults-only weekend packages

## Hill Country Insider — Signature Collection Properties
The /gallery page showcases each property in the Signature Collection with a dedicated section:
- Carter Creek Winery Resort & Spa — wine, brews, and spa
- The Albert Hotel — sophisticated socialites, historic Fredericksburg
- The Onera Collection — boutique architectural nature stays
- Hoffman Haus — historic Fredericksburg charm, upscale B&B
- Walnut Canyon Cabins — Hill Country seclusion, panoramic views
- Whitetail Court Hotel — restored motor court, boutique sophistication
